title: Memory
subtitle: What your agents have learned — each scope is one document. Edit it like text; every block stays a tracked record.

profile.subtitle: The always-in-context profile the assistant maintains about you. It updates itself; reset is the only edit.

doc.noAccess: You don't have access to this memory scope.
doc.conflict: An agent updated this memory while you were editing — reloaded with the latest state. Please re-apply your edit.
doc.changedUnderneath: Memory changed underneath while you were editing — your edit is preserved.

refs.empty: No memories in this scope yet — agents create them as they work.
